personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你细致、对地图有感觉、把「把精度做对」当标准，GIS 是空间数据圈最练人的入口。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI but simulation + automated characterization. Systems take over standard fabrication, while engineers with design skills gain greater stability.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: Not suited to people who dislike cleanrooms, cannot focus for long periods, or cannot tolerate repeated failure. Nanofabrication requires running equipment, tracking anomalies, and repeated validation, which is difficult for people who take setbacks personally.
fit_decision_checklist.how: Typical path: start in materials or microelectronics -> nanofabrication engineer -> device design -> process lead -> R&D manager.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: Best suited to people who enjoy deep investigation and hands-on work and can balance performance with manufacturability. If reliably producing nanostructures is your standard, you can build stability in this field.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you enjoy investigation and hands-on work and treat reliably producing nanostructures as the standard, nanoengineering is one of the strongest entry points for developing design skills in micro- and nanotechnology.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Systems thinking: sees the entire device
Attention to detail: identifies anomalies clearly

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「仿真 + 自动表征」——标准制备被系统吃，有设计力的人反而更稳。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合怕超净间、坐不住、受不了失败重试的人。纳米制备常跑设备、跟异常、反复验证，玻璃心很难受。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径：材料/微电子起步 → 纳米制备工程 → 器件设计 → 工艺负责 → 研发主管。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合钻研、爱动手、能在性能与可制造性间找平衡的人。你把「把纳米结构做出来又做稳」当标准，这行就稳。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你钻研、爱动手、把「把 nanostructure 做出来又做稳」当标准，纳米工程是微纳圈最练设计的入口。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI but being treated as a printout clerk. If you only know how to operate an autorefractor, you will indeed be replaced. Move toward care and management, and the optometrist's position becomes increasingly secure.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This work does not suit people who are careless, restless, or insensitive to detail. A refraction error of half a diopter can make a patient dizzy, so there is no room for carelessness.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: associate degree/bachelor's degree in optometry or optometric medicine → refractionist/optometrist professional credential → internship or employment at an optical store, eye clinic, or hospital ophthalmology department → experience and higher-level credentials → advancement toward vision-care specialist, store technical supervisor, or eye-health management.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits people who are meticulous, patient, and enjoy interacting with others. If you can tell whether a patient's statement that they cannot see clearly reflects a prescription problem or an eye disease and can crouch down to examine a child, this field suits you.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you enjoy the fulfillment of using expertise to help people see the world clearly and can work patiently while seated, optometry is a respected career that becomes more professional with experience.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Attention to detail: caring about even the smallest prescription difference
Patience: taking time to examine older adults and children
Communication: explaining professional information in plain language
Responsibility: every aspect of eye health matters
Learning ability: keeping up with new technologies and equipment

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「被当成打单员」——如果只会操作自动验光仪，你确实会被替代；往诊疗和管理走，验光师的位置反而越来越稳。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合毛躁、坐不住、对细节不敏感的人。验光差半个屈光度，患者就可能头晕，这行容不得马虎。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：大专/本科（眼视光学、眼视光医学专业）→ 取得验光员/验光师职业资格 → 在眼镜店、眼科门诊或医院眼科实习工作 → 积累经验考取更高级别资格 → 往视光师、门店技术主管或眼健康管理方向发展。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合心细、有耐心、爱跟人打交道的人。你能在患者一句「看不清」里分辨是度数问题还是眼病问题，能蹲下来给小朋友做检查，这行就适合你。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你享受「用专业帮人看清楚世界」的成就感，又坐得住、有耐心，验光师是一份越做越专业的体面工作。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 细心：度数差一点都较真
耐心：老人孩子慢慢检查
学习力：新技术新设备不断

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI, but knowing only how to record meters without judging the unit. Operators who understand processes, perform startups and shutdowns, and handle emergencies can withstand intelligent watchkeeping.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit careless people who cannot tolerate shifts or responsibility. Oil and gas facilities have extremely little tolerance for mistakes, and one operating error can cause severe consequences.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: study petrochemical engineering, oil and gas storage and transportation, or automation -> earn special-operation certificates for hazardous chemicals and related work -> join a refinery, gas plant, or pump station as an operations worker -> learn control-room operation and field inspection -> advance toward lead operator, shift supervisor, or process-unit technician.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits attentive, responsible people who adapt to shift work. It is ideal for those who can stay focused in the control room, willingly inspect process areas, and maintain constant safety awareness.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you accept demanding shifts and major responsibility in exchange for stability, solid pay, and valuable skills, this can be a long-term career.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Attention to detail: detect parameter fluctuations
Shift tolerance: night watchkeeping is routine
Patience: inspections and records repeat daily

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会抄表不会判断装置」——懂工艺、会开停工、能应急的操作工，才扛得住智能化值守。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合粗心大意、受不了倒班、怕担责任的人。油气装置事故容错率极低，一个操作失误可能造成严重后果。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：石油化工、油气储运或自动化相关专业 → 考特种作业相关证书（危化品等） → 进炼厂、气厂或泵站做运行操作工 → 从中控操作、巡检记录学起 → 往主操、班长、装置技术员方向发展。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合细心、有责任心、能适应倒班的人。能在中控室坐得住、又愿意跑装置区巡检，安全这根弦始终绷着，这行很合适。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你能接受「倒班辛苦、责任重大，但稳定、薪资不错、技能吃香」的现实，这行可以长期干。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 能倒班：夜班值守是常态
耐得住：巡检记录日复一日

boundary_notice: The greatest risk is system replacement. AI will not replace warehouses, but it replaces people who only scan; those who analyze data and handle exceptions become more valuable.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit careless people or those who dislike repetition. Repeated scanning and entry require patience, and responsibility rises when records do not reconcile.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is high school/secondary technical education, entry as receiving staff or inventory clerk, WMS and inventory-process mastery, logistics or supply-chain credentials, then warehouse supervisor, planner, or logistics specialist.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits careful, efficient people comfortable at computers and on warehouse floors. Counts, entries, and inventory checks must be accurate; impatience creates errors.

personality_fit_block.callout: For people who accept a low starting point and learn systems, warehouse clerk work is a ticket into supply chains.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Careful: counts and enters without errors
Efficient: receives, ships, and picks quickly
Organized: maintains orderly locations and documents
Collaborative: works with carriers, drivers, and suppliers

boundary_notice: 仓库文员最大的风险就是「被系统替代」——AI 不会取代仓库，但会取代只会扫码的人；会看数据、会处理异常的，反而更值钱。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合粗心、受不了重复劳动的人。天天扫同一批条码、录同一类单据，没点耐心撑不住；账对不上被查的时候，压力也全在你头上。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径：高中/中专即可入行 → 仓库收发员或库存文员做起 → 熟悉 WMS 系统与盘点流程 → 考物流师或供应链相关证书 → 晋升仓储主管、计划员、物流专员。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合细心、手脚麻利、坐得住电脑也站得住仓库的人。数箱要数得准，录单要录得快，盘库要盘得清；性子急的人最容易在盘点时出错。

personality_fit_block.callout: 不怕起点低、愿意往系统方向学的人，仓库文员是一张进供应链的门票。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 手脚麻利：收发拣货有效率
条理性：库位与单据井井有条
协作意识：跟物流司机供应商打交道
